what: The big button in the middle of the hero (from) drops into this element, the bottom-center fixed pill, the moment the bottom edge of the hero panel (past) rises 8px above the bottom of the screen. While falling it accelerates with cubic-bezier(.55,0,.9,.45), stretches vertically at 62% (.94·1.1), squashes at 74% (1.16·.8, 3px down), rebounds at 87% (.95·1.06, 4px up) and settles at .72s. The button stays hidden meanwhile. Scrolling back up, once the panel’s bottom edge drops more than 8px below the bottom of the screen, the pill returns to the button’s spot in .32s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) and disappears, and the button shows again.

options.from: CSS of the button that breaks away (required) — the pill size is fitted to this button
options.past: CSS of the panel that drops after passing (required)
options.dur: Drop duration (s), default .72 — 0 turns it on immediately
options.fx:dock · fx:undock: Event fired when the pill turns on or off — used to hide another fixed button (pause) along with it

use: Book a call
note: The pill’s skin (background, text, corners) is the user’s css. If the hero is short and the panel has already passed at the start, it drops as soon as the page opens

from.where: index.js button ↔ floor pill (.bk-book → .bk-float) — original wh-book → wh-float 720ms five-step keyframes
